description.en: A narrow, present-day concrete jail cell painted dull grey-green, with a scuffed grey concrete floor. Back wall: a small high rectangular window with steel bars, through which a pale shaft of daylight slants down into the cell. Left wall: a steel bunk bolted lengthwise along the wall, with a thin grey mattress, a folded grey wool blanket and a flat pillow. Right wall: the barred steel cell door, the only way in, which opens onto a dim corridor; beside it in the back-right corner stands a stainless-steel toilet-sink unit. Front wall (behind the camera): bare concrete with a small steel shelf. A caged fluorescent tube on the ceiling gives a flat, cold white top light.
description.zh: A narrow, present-day concrete jail cell painted dull grey-green, with a scuffed grey concrete floor. Back wall: a small high rectangular window with steel bars, through which a pale shaft of daylight slants down into the cell. Left wall: a steel bunk bolted lengthwise along the wall, with a thin grey mattress, a folded grey wool blanket and a flat pillow. Right wall: the barred steel cell door, the only way in, which opens onto a dim corridor; beside it in the back-right corner stands a stainless-steel toilet-sink unit. Front wall (behind the camera): bare concrete with a small steel shelf. A caged fluorescent tube on the ceiling gives a flat, cold white top light.

description.en: A present-day jail processing and release area with beige walls and a grey linoleum floor. A chest-high grey laminate front desk runs across the room, parallel to the back wall and a few steps in front of it, with a computer monitor and a tray on its top. Back wall: grey metal filing cabinets, a plain round wall clock and, at the back wall's left end, a heavy steel security door with a small wire-glass pane, which leads back to the cells. Right wall: a heavy steel exit door with a push bar and a small wire-glass window, the way out to the street. Left wall: a row of small grey steel property lockers and a steel bench bolted to the floor beneath them. Front wall (behind the camera): a cork notice board. Rectangular fluorescent ceiling panels give cool, even top light, and daylight comes in faintly through the exit door's small window on the right wall.

description.en: A quiet present-day city street outside a jail, in bright daylight. Back side: a tall chain-link fence topped with coils of razor wire, and behind it the blocky grey concrete jail building with narrow slit windows. A steel pedestrian gate in the fence, opposite the camera, is the way out of the jail. A wide grey concrete sidewalk runs along the fence, and the curb runs parallel to it across the frame, with an empty parking lane of dark asphalt in front of it. Left side: the road and the fence stretch away into the distance, with a streetlamp at the curb. Right side: the sidewalk continues past a row of young trees and a bus-stop pole. Front side (behind the camera): the far lane of the road and low buildings opposite. Sunlight falls from high on the left and casts short shadows to the right; the sky is clear.

description.en: A spacious, luxurious present-day living room in a wealthy suburban mansion, in cream, white and gold. Back wall: three tall arched French windows with sheer white curtains and gold tie-backs, through which daylight floods in from behind and slightly above, the main light source. Left wall: a white marble fireplace with a large gilt-framed mirror above it and two tall vases of white orchids on the mantel. Right wall: a wide open double doorway with white panelled doors, the way in from the marble entrance hall, and a gold console table beside it. Front wall (behind the camera): built-in white bookshelves. A crystal chandelier hangs from the centre of the ceiling and adds warm fill light. A long cream tufted three-seat sofa stands in the middle of the room with its back to the windows on the back wall, facing the camera. A low rectangular glass-and-gold coffee table stands in front of the sofa. A single cream upholstered armchair stands across the coffee table from the sofa, nearer the camera, its back to the camera and facing the sofa. A pale-grey patterned rug lies under the sofa, the table and the armchair, on a polished light wood floor.

description.en: The living room of a small but bright, clean and stylish present-day one-bedroom downtown apartment, with white walls, a pale oak floor and warm modern-minimalist décor. Back wall: on its left half, a large floor-to-ceiling window with sheer linen curtains looking out over the city skyline; by day, sunlight streams in through it from behind, and by night the city lights glow through it. On the right half of the back wall is the white panelled bedroom door, the only bedroom. Left wall: the apartment's front door, a dark-grey panelled door with a brass handle, which is the way in, with wall hooks and a slim oak shoe bench beside it. Right wall: a compact open kitchenette with white flat-front cabinets, a pale stone counter and two oak stools tucked under the counter's overhang. Front wall (behind the camera): low oak bookshelves. A charcoal-grey linen three-seat couch stands in the middle of the room, slightly left of centre, its back to the camera, facing the back wall's window, with a brass arc floor lamp at its left end and a low round oak coffee table in front of it. A small round light-oak dining table with two upholstered chairs stands in the right half of the room, between the couch and the kitchenette, nearer the bedroom door. A glass globe pendant lamp hangs over the dining table. At night the warm floor lamp from the left and the pendant over the table are the light sources; by day the window on the back wall gives soft, bright light.

description.en: A large, contemporary luxury living room in a wealthy suburban mansion, in daytime. The ceiling is high, the floors are polished cream marble, and the walls are pale grey with white crown moulding. At the centre, a low rectangular glass-and-gold coffee table sits on a large ivory rug. A long white tufted three-seat sofa faces two cream armchairs across the table. A crystal chandelier hangs overhead, with a fireplace with a white marble mantel behind the sofa and an abstract framed canvas above it. Tall potted fiddle-leaf figs flank the arched doorway the family enters through. Soft natural daylight pours from tall floor-to-ceiling windows with sheer white curtains along the left wall, casting warm side light across the seating. The chandelier is unlit and there are faint warm wall sconces.

At the far end a bier draped in white cloth holds the body, with a framed black-and-white portrait and a black-and-white silk flower above it. en: Si Nian steps out of the double wooden doors in her burial clothes and walks down the concrete steps to the street edge, dazed.

Lu Ren Jia rides his bicycle along the lane past the steps, turns his head and sees Si Nian in burial clothes, and his jaw drops.

Si Nian laughs through her tears, her face bright with joy.

Lin Qingyu glances toward the archway on the right wall, his expression serious, the phone at his ear.
Lin Qingyu's eyes narrow with quiet determination.
Lin Qingyu leans forward and lays his free hand flat on the marble table beside the vase of daisies.
Lin Qingyu keeps his lips closed while he listens. His brow tightens and his fingers tap the marble once.
Lin Qingyu cuts in without hesitation, and a faint confident smile touches his lips.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: The office in daylight. Ji Ran sits in the black leather chair behind the walnut desk. The four applicants stand in a row on the open floor facing her. Xu Banxia walks briskly from the walnut door to the door-side corner of the desk.
Xu Banxia stops at the door-side corner of the desk and leans toward Ji Ran with a polite, nervous smile. Ji Ran sits at the edge of the frame in the leather chair.
Ji Ran crosses her legs in the leather chair and runs a cool look along the row of applicants.
GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT straightens his back with the small dumbbell at his side and grins eagerly at the desk. BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT stands beside him.
Ji Ran leans back in the leather chair and rests her elbows on its padded arms.
BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT puffs out his chest and stiffens like a recruit. GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT stands beside him.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows. Lin Qingyu stands dripping just inside the open walnut door, Ji Ran stands on the oak floor a step from the door facing him, and Xu Banxia stands at the door-side corner of the desk.
Lin Qingyu, chest heaving, wet T-shirt clinging to him, pushes his wet fringe back and bows his head apologetically, Ji Ran's shoulder at the frame edge.
Ji Ran lets her eyes travel slowly from Lin Qingyu's face down his soaked body.
Ji Ran's mouth stays closed; one corner of her lips lifts in a cool, appraising half-smile.
Xu Banxia presses her lips together to hold in a laugh, walks from the desk corner past Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu, steps out through the walnut door and pulls it shut behind her.
Ji Ran folds her arms and walks slowly around Lin Qingyu, inspecting him, ending in front of him on the desk side, facing him, while he stands just inside the closed door.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: Over Lin Qingyu's wet shoulder, Ji Ran tilts her head, arms folded, sizing him up.
Lin Qingyu straightens up to his full height and squares his shoulders.
Ji Ran glances down at his waist, one brow raised.
Lin Qingyu nods quickly, water dripping from his fringe onto his denim jacket.
Ji Ran unfolds one hand and taps her chin, eyes narrowing.
Lin Qingyu flashes a bright, boyish, dimpled smile.

heading.en: INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE - NIGHT
heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE - NIGHT

en: Lu Shaoze stands at the walnut front door and smooths his swept-back hair with one hand. The elevator doors behind him across the landing are closed.
Lu Shaoze raises his knuckles and knocks on the walnut front door, smiling confidently.
The elevator doors slide open and Ji Ran steps out holding the black handbag. Lu Shaoze spins around, startled, and collides with her in the middle of the landing.
The two step apart and stop beneath the autumn landscape painting, Ji Ran on the elevator side and Lu Shaoze on the front-door side. Ji Ran steadies the black handbag on her arm and glares at him.
Lu Shaoze tilts his head with a mocking grin and spreads one hand toward Ji Ran.
Ji Ran raises one brow and gives a cool, thin smile, her hand resting on the handbag strap.

en: Lu Shaoze taps his own chest proudly with two fingers, facing Ji Ran beneath the painting.
Lu Shaoze raises his chin and adjusts the peaked lapel of his navy double-breasted suit jacket with a self-satisfied smile.
Lu Shaoze leans in with a smirk and gives a short smug snort.
Lu Shaoze reaches a hand toward Ji Ran's shoulder and she stiffens. Behind her, the elevator doors on the left wall slide open.

Lin Qingyu's white sneakers stride out of the elevator across the pale stone floor toward Ji Ran, the grocery bag full of greens swinging from one hand, bok choy and spring onions spilling from its top.

heading.zh: INT. APARTMENT CORRIDOR - NIGHT

en: Beneath the autumn landscape painting, Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran by the waist with the grocery bag of greens in his other hand. Lu Shaoze, on the front-door side, glares across the stone floor at his arm.
Lu Shaoze, in front of the walnut front door, jabs a finger at Lin Qingyu's arm around Ji Ran's waist, his face hard.

Under the painting, Lin Qingyu smiles brightly, slides his right arm off Ji Ran's waist and holds his right hand out toward the front door, the grocery bag still in his left hand. Ji Ran stays beside him.
Lin Qingyu keeps his hand extended toward Lu Shaoze's place by the front door, with a sunny, innocent grin.
Over Lin Qingyu's shoulder, Lu Shaoze stares down at the offered hand and folds his arms without taking it.
Lin Qingyu lowers his unshaken hand, turns his head to Ji Ran beside him under the painting and nudges her playfully. Ji Ran keeps her cool face toward the front door.

heading.zh: INT. APARTMENT CORRIDOR - NIGHT

en: Lu Shaoze shakes his head hard and thumps his own chest, glaring at Ji Ran.
Ji Ran rolls her eyes and tilts her head beneath the painting, arms still folded, a sliver of Lin Qingyu's shoulder at the frame edge.
Ji Ran lifts her chin and gives a dry, provoking half-smile toward the front door.
Lin Qingyu steps across the stone floor until he stands in front of Lu Shaoze and peers at his face with fake concern, the grocery bag in his left hand.
Lin Qingyu pats Lu Shaoze's shoulder twice with his right hand, smiling innocently. Lu Shaoze stiffens, his back to the front door.
Lu Shaoze knocks Lin Qingyu's hand off his shoulder with a swipe.

heading.en: INT. JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

en: Lin Qingyu leans back on the pale sofa. Ji Ran, arms folded, faces him across the marble-and-glass coffee table from the kitchen side, the night city glittering behind the windows.
Ji Ran looks down at Lin Qingyu with her arms folded and one eyebrow raised, the back of his head at the frame edge.
Lin Qingyu sits up straight on the sofa, rests his forearms on his knees and lifts his eyes to meet Ji Ran's.
Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran's gaze with a calm, earnest look and a hint of a smile.
Ji Ran's lips part slightly and her folded arms loosen as soft light and snowlike flecks drift across the image.
